هِرْدَبَّةٌ (and هِرْدَبٌّ, TA) An old woman. (S, K.) ―
-b2- Also, (as some say, TA,) Having a swollen belly, and cowardly: (S, K:) or cowardly, bulky, of little sense, swollen in the belly, and having no heart. (TA.) ―
-b3- Accord. to Az, in the T, A large, long-bodied man is called هِرْدَبَّةٌ. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
